Launch a Public Inquiry into Grooming Gangs, A taskforce has helped arrest hundreds of offenders since 2023. We believe abuse is large scale and ongoing. Yet we think the authorities refuse to acknowledge the background and motivation of abusers, the failures of police, social workers and local councillors, and potential cover-ups., In August 2014, a ground breaking report by former senior social worker Alexis Jay revealed that an estimated 1,400 children had been sexually exploited in Rotherham from 1997 to 2013, and the majority of known perpetrators were of Pakistani heritage. It revealed the failures of leadership and staff fears of being considered racist in identifying the ethnic origins of perpetrators. 
 
We think only a full public inquiry can force overdue change.

Home Office-led inquiry into historic child abuse in Oldham by grooming gangs, Oldham council have asked the government to hold an independent inquiry into the abuse of young British girls by grooming gangs. This was rejected without full discussion in parliament. This issue needs to be fully debated., Grooming gangs have been allowed to operate in numerous towns and cities across the country due to systemic failures by the authorities entrusted to protect our vulnerable. Lessons need to be learned, and correct safeguards need to be introduced.

Enquiry into grooming gangs, We demand an investigation, We all know of the tragedy of the grooming gang scandal that has plagued the uk for decades and it's effect on a swath of young girls.For some reason this labour government and the previous one found it not important enough to investigate why and how it happened.

 

Let's force they're hand and demand an investigation

Discuss why there won’t be a National Inquiry into Rape Gangs, The Labour Party has refused to initiate a Nationwide Inquiry into Rape Gangs in towns such as Oldham, Bradford, Oxford, Bristol and Aylesbury. This decision should be reversed so the public can understand what really happened and protect future generations from such barbaric abuse, The decision to not hold a public enquiry into Rape Gangs seems to have been to protect certain groups within our communities, but this just serves to foster mistrust and misunderstanding. There needs to be a full, open investigation which presents all communities with the facts, so the mistakes made by politicians, councils, social serves and the Police can be fully understood, and changes made to protect vulnerable young people in the future

Hold a National Inquiry into Grooming Gangs, The Government must hold an independent, nationwide inquiry into grooming gangs. This is a matter of national importance, addressing crimes so abhorrent that inaction undermines public confidence and trust., Failure to act is unacceptable. A thorough inquiry would:

Expose systemic failings that have allowed these crimes to persist.
Ensure accountability for perpetrators and enablers.
Provide justice and support for victims.
Establish safeguards to protect vulnerable individuals in the future.
The lack of decisive action is deeply concerning and risks further unrest. We demand accountability, transparency, and justice.

Home office to open an immediate public inquiry into GROOMING GANGS in  the uk, Prosecution and deportation of all foreign nationals involved in. Prosecute all citizens involved  in covering up any wrong doing .Prosecution of all political officials, social care  officials and law enforcement officials who helped felicitate in the cover up and protection of anyone culpable, Because the people of this country deserve to know the whole truth and nothing but the truth.
The victims deserve to be fully compensated for the evil crimes committed against them. 
And the people in power and law enforcement and social care need to be brought to account for any wrong doing or cover up , for what ever reason , personal , political or social .
And for all findings to be made public with immediate affect.

Hold a national inquiry into the mishandling of justice for gang rape victims, Establish a national inquiry into the mishandling of justice for gang rape victims in the past 25 years. Scope to cover local and national Government failures as well as policing failures., I believe the British public deserve the truth about the extent of these crimes and that those responsible for covering up are held to account and where necessary punished. The victims and their families deserve nothing less of those paid with public funds to serve them who have instead betrayed them.

Call for a public inquiry into the failure to protect girls from grooming gangs, The Government should establish a Public Inquiry into this without fear nor favour. It us important that the reasons these young girls were betrayed is exposed and that lessons are learned for the future, It has to be a National overarching Inquiry to ensure that National recommendations are made. The fear of offending a certain demographic has to be discussed and everyone treated or prosecuted equally

Establish a reparations scheme for victims of Grooming Gangs, We want the government to pay reparations to the victims of grooming gangs. We feel this is more appropriate than other reparations that people have proposed, such as for the transatlantic slave trade, because of the recency of this.,

Hold a Public Inquiry into Grooming Gangs., The victims of these gangs have been let down by the establishment for the sake of diversity. This needs to to debated so it never happens again., Future generations of young people can feel safe and protected by the authorities within the borders of their own country.

National Inquiry into rape gangs, There is need for a national inquiry into all the rape gangs through many cities of this country. Rape of many many innocent girls., This is a national disgrace and more is needed to stop it continuing.

Demand for a Public Inquiry into Grooming, Rape, & Systemic Cover-Ups in the UK, Uncover the truth, Ensure accountability, prevent future failures, support survivors., The government and Parliament have the authority, responsibility, and resources to address this critical issue effectively. By initiating a public inquiry, they can:
Uphold Accountability, Demonstrate Commitment to Justice, Legislate for Change, Restore Public Trust, Provide Support for Survivors. 

By leading this effort, the government and Parliament fulfill their duty to protect citizens, uphold justice, and ensure systemic failures are not repeated.

We demand a full and independent inquiry into grooming gangs, We urge the UK government to establish a full, independent inquiry into grooming gangs. This inquiry must ensure accountability for those responsible, address failures by authorities, and provide justice and support for victims., For decades, victims of grooming gangs have suffered abuse, often without adequate support or justice. Concerns have been raised about systemic failures by local councils, police forces, and other institutions in protecting vulnerable individuals. An independent inquiry is essential to investigate these failings, hold perpetrators and negligent authorities accountable, and recommend robust measures to prevent such atrocities in the future. This inquiry will also provide victims with the recognition and justice they deserve

To promote animal adoption, ban the sale of cats and dogs, Ban the buying and selling of cats and dogs. This could ultimately close down businesses that breed cats and dogs., Therefore, female cats and dogs would not have to go through regular pregnancy and labour - only to lose their children. As a result of breeding, most shelters are overpopulated, and even healthy cats and dogs are regularly euthanised - if they are not adopted, due to a lack of space, resources or money.

Hold a public enquiry into the grooming and rape gangs that prey on girls., Hold a debate on the grooming culture of young girls that seems so rife across the UK., The horrific detailed that are circulating in the national press need to be fully understood by the population and can only be properly investigated by a judge led public enquiry into the scandal since a number of public bodies seem to have been brought into disrepute including police forces.

To commission a full public inquiry into historic sexual abuse by grooming gangs, British Institutions have seriously let down our children who were horrifyingly abused by predominantly Pakistani men. They - the young girls - deserve justice & this inquiry must provide in full institutional failings, including CPS, Police, Councils & Social Services., The lack of institutional appetite for transparency and accountability necessitates a thorough inquiry into these horrendous crimes to Communities across the UK.

Urgently conduct a National Public Inquiry into Pakistani grooming gangs., I'm calling on the Government to conduct an urgent National Public Inquiry into the Pakistani grooming gangs. There are historic institutional failures which must be robustly investigated to hold those responsible to account and give justice to the survivors., The survivors have been badly let down by the very institutions that are supposed to protect them. Lesson must be learnt, and those responsible must be held to account.

National inquiry into all rape gangs and subsequent cover ups, Investigate the atrocities carried out over the last few decades by rape gangs on young white girls, To expose the cover ups and failings of Police, Councils, CPS, Social Work, Politicians etc The victims who suffered these appalling crimes against them need closure

UK wide independant inquiry into grooming gangs., There needs to be a UK wide, fully independant inquiry into grooming gangs. This is potentially the worst scandal in UK history and must be investigated to the fullest., The grooming gang scandal is a stain on the UK and must be fully investiated with those involved brought to justice. The inquiry should involve all of the victims and their families. The inquiry should investigate any possible involvment and/or cover up by, but not limited to, local councils, the police, CPS and MPs.

A full government investigation & enquiry into the mass grooming scandal., I want a full Enquiry into how much the government, local council and the local authorities had involvement in covering up the grooming scandals for the last 20 years., To seek justice for those who have been made victims of sexual rape & misconduct by the justice system.

National inquiry of rape gangs & holding those accountable who covered it up !!, Any agency involved in the cover up be investigated and legally held accountable for the actions.. it’s the worst disgrace to hit this country and has been ignored for years!! No child should be put through this nor should their family’s they are human beings not to belet down horrendously for votes, help promised & followed through for all survivors !!! No ethnicity should be held in higher regard than any other … all foreign predators to be deported permanently!!!!

Child grooming gang public inquiry, We the general public demand a public inquiry into the biggest child abuse scandal to ever happen. 
The public and the victims deserve this and the people involved need to be held accountable., The biggest scandal involving crimes against children needs a full independent public inquiry. These are horrific crimes, covered up by some of the most powerful people in the country. The public would like to demand an inquiry into this scandal and see the people involved held accountable in criminal court for their involvement in allowing this to continue for so many years. We the public demand answers. Crimes against the most vulnerable in this country have gone on too long.

Call a fully open and transparent inquiry into the extent of the Grooming Gangs, The ilsca children's inquiry did not go far enough in its investigation into the grooming gangs,the ethnicity of the perpetrators and the victims., We would like Parliament to call a far reaching public inquiry

We demand a national inquiry into the rape gang scandal to report, To set up an inquiry into the rape gang scandal. It is obvious that this is a national issue and that there was collusion and institutional cover ups at local and potentionally national level., The local inquiries, whilst useful, do not have the required powers to force attendance, or investigate the national implications of this issue. These operated on a national basis and the failure to accept the evidence of the victims and the failure from local and national politicians, police and others mean that a national inquiry is necessary

Open a Public enquiry into grooming gangs, Open an enquiry into the cover up of grooming gangs and hold any official to account, There has been a massive cover up and there needs to be a full investigation to bring this to an end

Launch a full public inquiry into the rape gangs scandal, To launch a full, transparent, and independent national inquiry into the industrial-scale rape and grooming of young British girls. The inquiry must examine the systemic failures of institutions, local authorities, law enforcement and political leadership that allowed these crimes to take place., Victims have endured unimaginable suffering, and an inquiry must uncover whether those entrusted with their protection—law enforcement, local councils, authorities, and political leaders—failed in their duties or deliberately suppressed investigations to avoid controversy.

Only a national inquiry can deliver full accountability, justice for survivors, and the systemic reforms needed to ensure such failures are never repeated.

A full public inquiry into the child rape gangs, We ask His Majesty’s Government to undertake a full transparent public inquiry into the scale and response of the “grooming gang scandal”, including sexual exploitation of children by men, as emerged in Rotherham, Rochdale, Oxford ect., To commission a full independent inquiry where all agencies are investigated and consider whether or not their responses were timely. It is now essential that the public and victims feel that genuine concerns around this are fully addressed. There must be lessons learnt and reassurances given that future responses must not be influenced by gender, religion, ethnicity ect.

Call a full public investigation into the Pakistani grooming and rape gangs., We want the government to fully investigate and publish the findings of,  the Pakistani grooming and rape gangs that have been operating in this country and, the failures of the establishment and police involved ., We want all those involved brought to justice and sacked from any position they may still hold. Prison sentences where required. Followed by the deportation of any perpetrators that are of foreign or mixed nationality. We want justice.

Fund access to Holistic Needs Assessment for all NHS cancer patients & follow-up, As a 45-year-old battling cancer, I know it is the toughest ordeal many will face. It's as much a mental battle as it is physical. We believe the NHS should ensure mental health support. So we're calling for funding for Holistic Needs Assessments for all NHS cancer patients., We think this would treat cancer patients as people, not just bodies that respond to treatment. We think all cancer patients should be given an assessment when they are first diagnosed and solutions should be put in place to solve problems relating to attendant mental health issues. We think medical teams should monitor mental health at every appointment by asking questions so they can act and refer them to appropriate support.

Hold a public national inquiry into grooming gangs, Hold a full public national inquiry into grooming gangs, The Government need to get a defined action plan to resolve this issue once and for all and expose those that were complicit in failing to support vulnerable children.

Set up an independent task force separate from police to target grooming gangs, We want the government to set up a specialist anti child grooming task force that will operate independently from the Police and Local Authorities., We think that the other inquiries and initiatives have failed our children.
Enquiry into child abuse & gang rape, Enquiry into young girls being raped, Keir Starmer wants to stop an enquiry

Carry out a full national inquiry into 'Grooming Gangs', Carry out a full enquiry into 'Grooming Gangs' across the UK, and identify any officials complicit in covering up the full extent of the problem., It is long overdue, and necessary to ensure those responsible face justice, and that they do not remain in positions of power.

Review minimum sentences for perpetrators of violence and sexual abuse, We think the Government should review minimum sentences for abuse against females and children, rape, sex trafficking young girls, violence against women, child prostitution, Female Genital Mutilation, honour-based violence, date rape and social drink drugging females, harming vulnerable people. , We believe this kind of abuse is a form of terrorism.

Conduct full investingation into grooming gangs in UK., Allow independent third parties and government autorities to fully prosecute and properly look into and resolve issues of gangs, starting with grooming gangs all around country., Recent call against investingation into grooming gangs is just vile and disgusting, we, as people living here and politicians should both strive for a safe enviroment for our most vulnerable, children, which are abused in this country on a unprecedented rate. There should be proper investigation into the situation on all levels of society, social service, politicians, officers, we, as parent shouldn't keep our kids in homes due to fear of grooming gangs, rapes, and abuse.

Do not describe sexual abuse of children as "grooming" by "grooming gangs", I want the Government and Parliament to stop using the words "grooming" and "grooming gangs". I feel they are euphemisms being used in official publications to describe horrible, violent sexual abuse of children including rape, torture, kidnapping and imprisonment., I think that the use of euphemisms to describe criminal offences does considerable harm. A 12-year-old child who has been raped may not think she has been "groomed".

Ban chewing tobacco to prevent cancer and litter, We would like the Government to ban the import and sale of chewing tobacco products to and in the UK. Chewing tobacco can cause cancer and we feel that the spitting in residential streets and shopping areas causes a great deal of litter., We feel that it is a danger to health and creates a great deal of environmental damage through littering and anti social spitting in streets and public spaces. We believe that local people are fed up with it and local authorities are having to spend money to clean it up.

Have a National inquiry into child abuse and gang rapes, Have a National inquiry into child abuse and gang rapes. Never mind the fact that the Prime Minister instructed his MP’s to vote it down. That is obstruction of justice in democrat and dictatorial. ., Since the last inquiry more cases of come to light where young girls where failed by the authorities and theirs stories need to be heard and the perpetrators brought to justice. 

I want the government to move forward with an inquiry to bring justice to the victims whereby the  perpetrators should forced to pay compensation to those victims and then be imprisoned after which there citizenship is stripped and they are deported.

Fund improvements for victims reporting rape, We want the government to follow the recommendations of the Victims Commission to increase the reach of operation Soteria, investigating the effectiveness of the justice process including the CPS. , Make Section 28 video testimony standard for rape cases. Increase police and court resources for speedier resolutions.

We feel that victims of rape are being scandalously failed by the justice system. More than 99% of rapes reported to police do not end in a conviction. We feel there are far too many delays, with cases usually taking more than a year, sometimes three. Trials can be postponed, sometimes on the day, often repeatedly. Victims can be retraumatised by the process, to the extent that many give up.
 
We think this situation is shameful and unacceptable.

Stop the cross channel immigrants landing., Instead of RNLI and the Border Force picking up illegal immigrants and bringing them to the UK they should return them to a beach in France., Because our country is under pressure at every level, housing, schooling, the NHS. Also the criminality is out of control … child abuse, rape, murders, drug gangs, knife crime, shop lifting.

Deport people with dual nationality who are found guilty of raping children, We think the Grooming Gangs scandal is possibly the biggest scandal in our country's history. It is time for a tough approach. We are calling for foreign born nationals with dual nationality who are found guilty of raping children to be deported.,

Require magistrates courts to record court hearings so there is a record, The magistrates court is currently is a court of no record. We want magistrates courts to start recording hearings so there is a record of what was said within the proceedings of the hearing., We think this could prevent magistrates misconducting themselves and assist with complaints. Where a complaint is made to the advisory committee about the behaviour of a magistrate, we think this could assist in an prompt, transparent and fair investigation.
 
We think this could restore the public faith in the courts and prevent undue miscarriages of justice.

Demand afull national investigation into child sex abuse and sex gangs in the UK, Conduct a full national investigation into child sex abuse and sex gangs in the UK. Hold all accountable including those who have ignored and covered up this scandal, Conduct a full national investigation into child sex abuse and sex gangs in the UK. Hold all accountable including those who have ignored and covered up this scandal

Introduce random alcohol & drug testing within the House of Commons, We want the government to introduce random alcohol and drug testing within the House of Commons, The Palace of Westminster is a place of Government. It is also the place that legislation is passed that governs us all.
 
Therefore, great responsibility and privilege is afforded to MPs. In the interests of the highest possible standards, we think random alcohol and drug testing needs to be introduced.

Legal requirement to test and record blood group at birth for medical records, I would like there to be a legal requirement for blood group to be tested at birth. This would then be on our medical records for life. I would also like there to be an official card people could carry stating their blood type so it is easy to access along with our medical history., Many people don't know their blood group unless they need to for medical reasons or have given blood. In an emergency where someone needs a blood transfusion, blood has to be taken and tested. Valuable time and money is wasted in this process. Carrying a card (as diabetics do, for example) or accessing medical records with blood types recorded could save lives. A card could also be kept visible at home, as other medical emergency information often is, in case a medic/ambulance attends the home.

Remove people on the terror watch list from the UK, In 2020, the Home Office said there were over 40,000 people where MI5 judged there was some risk of them re-engaging in terrorist activity. We think people on this list who are in the UK should be deported, to keep people in the UK safe., People in the UK should be safe in their own country and we think having potential terrorists among us isn’t safe. We feel we are under threat. We think we should not have to live like this, and that the government has a duty to protect the people of this country.

Make it so school toilets cannot be locked ever, During educational hours schools will lock the toilets and will deny us of our basic human rights of going to the toilet, so I am asking for a law or change within this to make it so schools cannot do this, As many students have medical problems cant access the toilets if this happens what are they meant to do, if a teenage girl is on her period how is she meant to change tampon or pad during school if her flow is heavy it is a very common and concerning problem that occurs nationwide
Fund airport-style security for all schools to screen students for drugs, I want the government to give funding to all schools for airport-style security to screen the students for drugs.,

Increase funding to combat violence against women and girls in the UK & abroad, We urge the Government to act now and increase funding to support services to combat violence against women and girls to ensure better police training, improved prosecution rates, better prevention programs, support for marginalised women, and international aid to women in places like Afghanistan., Violence against women and girls in the UK is rising. It was estimated there were 1.1 million crimes in the year ending in March 2024, including nearly 70,000 rapes, yet only 2.6% of rapes result in a charge. An estimated 2.4 million people are affected by domestic abuse every year.  We believe urgent action must be taken on support, prevention, and justice, including specialist services for marginalised women and international aid for women in places such as Afghanistan.

Review how cases involving domestic violence are assigned to court location, We call for a review to consider how court locations could best be chosen to prioritise the survivor's safety, and potentially reduce emotional stress and prevent further harm.
 , We think that domestic violence survivors should not have to attend courts near their home or work, as this could risk encounters with their abuser. 

Many survivors of domestic violence already face immense emotional and physical trauma. The current system assigns court locations based on where the case started, often near the survivor’s home or workplace, risking encounters with the abuser. We feel this could increase fear and stress and discourage victims from seeking justice. 
 
We think courts should ensure a supportive environment for victims to pursue justice without further trauma or intimidation.

Allocate annual funding to accelerate breakthroughs in MND research , We want the Government to allocate annual regular funding for the purpose of research, clinical trials, all stages of trials, in order to prolong the lives of MND patients in a meaningful way. We want innovative research to be prioritised. MND is life limiting still., Type 1 diabetes was a death sentence until 1923. Cancer was a death sentence 50 years ago, now many patients get active treatment, and it may no longer be life-limiting if caught early. HIV was a death sentence until 1996. Now, it isn't a life-limiting condition, if given proper treatment. We think that increased regular funding would help to prolong the lives of MND patients in a meaningful way. We think funds, research, and money is needed.

Abolish the planned Vehicle tax for electric, zero or low emission vehicles., Establish a fair taxation approach which rewards citizens for adopting clean transport technologies in advance of the ban on the sale of new diesel and petrol cars from 2035., The planned tax is unfair to EV drivers, some polluting ICE vehicles are tax exempt due to their low emissions.
Public charging network prices are uncapped and subject to 20% VAT. EV drivers are already paying more per mile than ICE drivers.
The absence of any fiscal incentives for citizens to transition to zero emission vehicles means the sector is unlikely to meet it's targets, resulting in both environmental and economic impacts.

Review protections for victims to keep custody of their children, We urge the UK Government and Parliament to investigate how to best protect parents who are victims of human trafficking or domestic abuse, or who are otherwise vulnerable, from losing custody of their children. We think there are systemic failures in the system., We think the review should look at amending the Modern Slavery to mandate retraining for local authority staff on handling human trafficking victims with trauma. 

Removing children from traumatized parents is unjust, exacerbates their suffering, and ignores the need for compassionate care. We request an urgent review to protect these families.

Make it illegal for people to wear full face balaclavas in public places, Ban the wearing of full face balaclavas at any time of day or night in public places, In Monton, Manchester there is an increase of teenagers wearing all black with black full face balaclavas attacking and assaulting people and children, often at knife point. They attack on electric bikes in gangs.  Without face coverings im sure they would not be as 'brave'! A policeman was pushed off his bike in broad daylight by a gang of such youths recently. Im sure this is a national concern. There are no meaningful deterrents anymore , these kids so not care who they hurt or target

Launch a public inquiry to investigate political bias in the national media , We believe the Government needs to launch a full public inquiry to investigate political bias in the national media and how the national media operates.,

Urgent Action Needed: New Measures to Address Hepatitis B, We ask the Government to:
1. Increase funds for Hepatitis B research, treatment, & early detection.
2. Launch a national awareness campaign targeting high-risk groups.
3. Implement routine Hepatitis B screening for at-risk people.
4. Ensure timely access to medical care for Hepatitis B patients., Thousands may unknowingly live with undiagnosed Hepatitis B, potentially discovering it too late for effective intervention. Despite available vaccines and treatments, we are concerned the UK government has failed to address the issue with minimal public health campaigns, no routine screening for at-risk groups, and inconsistent care for those diagnosed. Hepatitis B is the most common risk factor for liver cancer, and without early detection, the progression to liver cancer may be inevitable.

Establish an Independent Inquiry into alleged Sexual Abuse in the Armed Forces, We think the government should set up an independent inquiry into allegations of sexual abuse in the Armed Forces., There are many reports on social media of sexual abuse in the armed forces. We think the military and the government need to take this seriously and set up an inquiry to investigate properly.

Review laws allowing perpetrators of domestic abuse legal access to children, I would like the government to conduct a comprehensive review of existing laws and amend them so as to close any loopholes that may allow perpetrators to manipulate legal systems and gain access to children and previous victims of domestic violence., I think existing laws often lack clear definitions and criteria for assessing threat to children, potentially resulting in unsafe judicial decisions made in family courts. I think such threats can foreshadow further attempts of abuse toward the targeted victim which may result in loss of life. I think reviewing these laws will help ensure victims and their children fleeing abuse are truly kept safe. I feel the loopholes are a major factor in domestically violent crimes.

Create a trauma-informed task force to develop a strategy to address trauma , We think trauma is an unaddressed public health issue, with no nationwide strategy to address it. We feel a coordinated, cross-sector, trauma-informed response is essential. We urge the Government to develop a trauma-informed taskforce to create a more compassionate, effective, equitable system., We think the government should embed trauma-informed (TI) principles into laws and policies, across health and social care, education, and criminal justice. We would like a cross-government task force to develop a strategy for and deliver a system response to trauma, promoting early intervention (to both prevent trauma and to intervene sooner with appropriate support for those impacted by trauma), reducing inequalities in health and life course from birth, and fostering a TI workforce.

Lower the age for invites to regular mammograms to 40., Currently the age for routine mammograms to start is 50. I believe this should be lowered to 40., I was recently diagnosed with breast cancer at age 41. I have no close family history of any cancer including breast or ovarian cancer. I was lucky to find my lump early and my outlook currently is positive. 
 
During my journey it has become apparent that more young people are being diagnosed with breast cancer. I think it's essential that people are aware of their bodies and have the opportunity to catch this as early as possible. I think this would help save lives.

Introduce consequences for local authorities that ignore antisocial behaviour, Introduce legal consequences for local authorities that fail to address antisocial behaviour., Make Environmental Health departments accountable for failures to deal with antisocial behaviour.
 
Prosecute Environmental Officers where there is demonstrated breach of duty.
 
We think antisocial behavior negatively impacts individuals, families, and communities. It may lead to social isolation and poor mental health. It may result in stress, strained relationships, and emotional distress.
 
We think communities are facing increased crime, fear, and a decline in social cohesion, which can put a strain on public services. We think overall, antisocial behaviour creates a cycle of harm that affects quality of life in society.

Set up an independent inquiry into the UK’s involvement in the war in Gaza, We urge the Government to set up an independent inquiry into the UK’s involvement in the war in Gaza, including arms sales, military support, and political actions. We believe the public deserves transparency, and that a democratic country should be accountable for its role in conflicts., We believe a democratic government must be transparent and accountable to the people. We believe citizens have the right to know how their taxes are used. Many consider that the UK’s involvement in the Gaza war raises serious legal and ethical concerns. We believe a full independent inquiry is necessary to ensure accountability and uphold the principles of democracy and justice.

Create a national screening program for prostate cancer, I would like the government to make this test mandatory 
PSA test – This blood test checks PSA levels, which can be high due to cancer but also due to other conditions like an enlarged prostate., No automatic screening – The NHS follows a "shared decision-making" approach, meaning men can discuss the risks and benefits of the PSA test with their Doctor.
 Prostate cancer is a significant health concern in the UK, being the most common cancer among men.Each year, more than 12,000 men die from prostate cancer in the UK, averaging 33 deaths daily
These statistics highlight the importance of awareness, early detection, and targeted interventions to reduce prostate cancer mortality in the UK

Launch a public inquiry into concerns about free speech in the UK, We would like Government to launch a public inquiry into free speech in the UK, including criminal offences relating to social media posts., We believe the prison system is clearly overstretched and under resourced. We are concerned about reports of people being prosecuted due to what they may have posted on social media.

Ban schools from suspending pupils under the age of 7, We believe children under the age of 7 should not be suspended from school. Many children below that age may have undiagnosed learning or behaviour needs, and this can be especially true for children from a trauma background like adopted children or those in care., Children at this age can often be impulsive and/or have very little self-control or self-regulation, especially those with additional needs who may be waiting years for a diagnosis let alone help.

Require all military sexual assault claims be handled by civilian authorities, We think that responsibility for all sexual assaults should be transferred to civilian authorities.
, From Jan 2018-Apr 2024, only 23% of the 93 rape cases heard in military court martials resulted in convictions. This conviction rate is lower than the average 70% conviction rate for rape cases in civilian court.

Government plays a key role to ensure we live in a fair society. Women make up just 11% of the British armed forces and hold only 5% of senior roles. We think this significant underrepresentation contributes to a culture where inappropriate behaviour is often normalised. Unpunished inappropriate behaviour can deter women from wanting to serve in the British forces making it more difficult to attract high calibre candidates.

Fund cervical smear tests for women above age 64, Cervical smear testing is a proven preventative method of avoiding cervical cancer yet after age 64 these tests stop. However mortality rates from this disease in older women are high, as shown on the Cancer Research U.K. website., We think Cervical smear tests should continue after age 64.
We think far too many women above age 64 are dying from cervical cancer because smear tests are no longer available beyond that age. Are women over 64 somehow less important? In particular we think grandmothers are a vital link in the chain to enable parents, particularly mothers, to work and contribute to the economic wellbeing of our country.
We think ending smear tests at 64 makes no sense and in addition to being unkind & unfair it is expensive for the U.K. from a health economics viewpoint.

Fund access to abiraterone in England for high-risk prostate cancer patients, Abiraterone has been available in Scotland and Wales for two years for high-risk patients whose cancer has not yet spread but not in England and Northern Ireland. I want the government fund abiraterone for men in England, giving them the treatment they deserve and has been proven to work., I think it is unfair that men are not receiving the treatment.
Research has shown that for these earlier stage patients, the survival rate after six years is improved and that the drug halved the rate of progression of the cancer.

Allow English men access to Abiratarone, Grant NHS prescriptions for Abiratarone for men diagnosed with stage 4 prostate cancer, I was with stage 4 prostate cancer in July 2024. I will never be free of this awful condition. The best I can hope for, is it can controlled. One drug that could help is Abiratarone. This is available on prescription in Scotland and Wales. But not in England!

Why the hell not? 

Many men in England are suffering from prostate cancer. If they were your family members. Would you not fight for their lives?

Child contact with parent arrested/bailed for domestic abuse to be supervised , We want the Government to set requirements that during family court proceedings, once a parent is arrested and bailed for domestic abuse, they are only allowed supervised contact with their children by social services, CAFCASS and the family courts system., We want the Government to set requirements that during family court proceedings, once a parent is arrested and bailed for domestic abuse, they are only allowed supervised contact with their children by social services, CAFCASS and the family courts system.
We think this will better support and recognise the true impacts of domestic abuse and allow opportunities for victims of the abuse to come forward without fear of losing custody of their children to abusive parents. We also think this could better safeguard and protect children to prevent abuse.

Rejection of the ban on Ecollars and training tools in Scotland., Dog owners and trainers across Scotland would like to make a stand against the ban of Ecollars and potentially other vital training tools, by urging the Government to review the suggested ban., Ecollars and other training tools such as prong collars, slip leads and check chains play a critical part daily in the rehabilitation of thousands of dogs across Scotland. Ecollars and the other tools mentioned above have saved the lives of many dogs that positive only training has failed. By banning ecollars and other training tools so many dogs will unnecessarily be euthanised and livestock attacks will rise.

Lower the age for invites to regular mammograms to 21, We want the government to make mammograms regularly available for younger ages. People in their 20s, 30s and 40s also get and die from breast cancer.,

Ban the sale of defaced power tools & large power tool sales at car boot fairs, We urge the Government to pass a law which bans the sale of power tools with a defaced or removed serial number, and which bans the sale of large power tools at car boot fairs., Every year, many tradespeople have their vehicles broken into with tools worth large amounts of money taken. This can hurt people’s lives, mentally and financially, and one of the reasons that criminals may not ever be caught is because the tools are sold online or at boot fair sales with serial numbers defaced/scratched off. This can make tools untraceable and allow criminals to profit off of damaging other people’s livelihoods.

Decriminalise all drug possession for personal use & fund support, We urge the government to decriminalise all drug possession for personal use and shift resources to health-based solutions. We believe criminalisation has failed and it’s time for a new approach. We want the Government to fund addiction treatment, mental health support, and education., We believe criminalising drug use wastes billions, fuels mass incarceration, and worsens public health. We think countries like Portugal have shown that treating addiction as a health issue, not a crime, can reduce overdoses, disease, and drug-related crime. We believe punishment fails to address the root causes, and a health-first approach can save money, improve safety, and restore dignity. We believe decriminalisation is a humane, cost-effective path forward.

Review rules on & launch an inquiry into the removal of asbestos, I call for the Government to launch an inquiry to investigate how asbestos removal is taking place, and how asbestos is being tested for, and to review the rules on this., It is estimated that 5,000 people die each year due to asbestos-related diseases. 

We believe there should be inquiry into asbestos removal and a review into the rules, to help prevent or reduce further loss of life. We are concerned about the adequacy of testing approaches.

Review justice system approach to domestic & sexual abuse & coercive control, We feel that too many victims of domestic abuse, sexual violence, and coercive control are suffering because our justice system is slow, ineffective, and can fail to protect them. We believe that some perpetrators are walking free without consequences and that this needs to change., We believe that defence lawyers can exploit loopholes to delay justice and that delays in convictions force victims to relive trauma. We feel that abusers can manipulate the system to avoid accountability thereby re-traumatising survivors. We want the Government to review and reform the justice system to make changes.
Some ideas for reform include: 
- Faster convictions for domestic and sexual abuse cases 
- Stronger bail conditions

Require NHS hospitals & clinics to provide after-treatment surveys, I urge the Government to require NHS hospitals and clinics to provide end of treatment surveys to patients or families at the end of care/treatment. I would like this to be sent to an independent review board and assessed so that any serious complaints are dealt with properly., I am calling for there to be an independent board that can accurately assess and investigate serious complaints through a mandatory post treatment/care survey to patients and families. These surveys could then be reviewed by the independent board.

Government to do more to protect victims of false allegations, We want the Government to impose shorter time limits on pre-charge bail and introduce strong minimum penalties for those making false allegations. We think it is important that the due process and rights of the accused are protected, and that there should be a system to support those falsely accused, We call on the Government to promote balanced media reporting, and to commission regular reviews to improve investigative practices. We think that the current legal system often overlooks the rights of the accused, hindering fair due process and equal treatment. We believe that exonerated individuals face immense stigma and struggle to rebuild their lives without adequate support. We think regular reviews of criminal investigations ensures thoroughness and prevents miscarriages of justice.

Launch a public inquiry into UK arms exports to Israel and suspend all licences, We call on the Government to immediately establish a public, judge-led inquiry into British arms exports to Israel and to suspend licences during the investigation. Many are concerned that Israel has violated international law, and the inquiry should look at the role of UK components., We are concerned about UK military exports to Israel since October 2023, and how they have been used. We believe a Chilcot-style inquiry is needed to examine export decisions and establish accountability. We consider that this is a legal, ethical, and humanitarian necessity.

Ban the sale of nicotine products to anyone born on or after 1 January 2009, We are calling for the Tobacco and Vapes Bill to go further and ban the sale of all nicotine products, including vapes, to anyone born on or after 1 January 2009. We think this would protect those already harmed by marketing campaigns and mean vapes are used only as smoking cessation tools., We think the government’s delayed action has allowed children to be harmed, and it is now their moral duty to right that wrong. In our view, vapes are a smoking cessation tool, not a product to attract new users. We think a full ban on the sale of all nicotine products, including vapes, to anyone born on or after 1 January 2009 is the only appropriate and responsible course of action.

Keep Crawley in West Sussex NOT in Surrey, Do NOT merge West Sussex and Surrey, West Sussex will suffer increase in house prices, council tax, and ULEZ will be considered for Crawley but we are NOT part of London. We are over 25 miles from London and outside the M25. We will lose all our history.

Lower bowel cancer screening age to 30 & funding for investigation of symptoms, We call on the Government to lower the bowel cancer screening age to 30, and provide funding to ensure all patients with symptoms of bowel cancer are fully and quickly investigated, regardless of age, to help prevent further loss of life due to delayed diagnosis., Bowel cancer is increasing in younger adults and we don't think the current approach reflects this. Early action could save lives.

Prohibit disclosure of pre-trial therapy notes in sexual assault investigations, We want the government to amend the law on disclosure to prohibit access to pre-trial therapy notes of sexual assault survivors. We think that for these survivors, usually women and girls, the justice system is appalling and extremely challenging to navigate and they face restrictive rules., We feel they're unable to fully address trauma with therapists while an investigation is still ongoing.
 
We think survivors deserve the right to speak freely about their experiences, even as investigations are underway, and not risk having this used against them in the court of law. We believe the law fails to consider survivors' mental health and their emotional recovery, and that sharing stories is a crucial avenue for healing, that should not be used in the courtroom against women and girls.

Require all public buildings to display the Union Jack flag, We believe in celebrating and honouring the rich history and heritage of the United Kingdom. We think displaying the Union Jack on public buildings will serve as a daily reminder of our collective history, fostering a sense of pride and belonging among citizens of all backgrounds., We think seeing the Union Jack flying proudly would inspire patriotism and remind us of the values and traditions that have shaped our nation. By visibly showcasing our flag, we think we could strengthen our national identity and ensure that future generations understand and appreciate the legacy of the United Kingdom. Therefore, we respectfully request the government to implement a policy that encourages the regular and respectful display of the Union Jack flag on public buildings.

Launch an inquiry into online disinformation on social media platforms, We call on the Government to launch a public inquiry into social media disinformation, focusing on foreign state influence. We want the inquiry to look into the impact that disinformation has on the views of the general public., We are concerned about social media’s influence, and a lack of transparency. We feel it may be leading to widespread disinformation that is altering the general public’s views.

Require all social housing flats to have a personal balcony/garden, We urge the Government to require all existing and newbuild social housing to have a personal balcony if above ground floor, as it can help reduce depression or help with future house swaps, as some house swappers may not consider sites with no balcony or garden due to a lack of outside space., We believe we must discuss social housing matters that impact people on a regular basis. We believe that by requiring housing associations and councils to make sure their properties have a balcony, or garden may help with people’s mental health, and that this is a step they should take. As I live in a flat with no personal outside space, this is my last option as many people on sites like homeswapper don't consider properties that don't have balconies; making it harder to find a swap.

Mandate drug testing for all Members of Parliament, including the Prime Minister, Narcotics can affect one's ability to think and make important decisions. The integrity and competency of our leaders are paramount for the successful governance of our nation. members of parliament should also be held to the highest standards of responsibility and accountability., Regular drug tests for members of parliament will not only promote accountability but also transparency. This process will act as a deterrent against substance misuse and would also help cultivate public trust in our governmental institutions. It highlights a commitment to integrity and ethical leadership that citizens expect from their representatives. The goal is to maintain a government led by individuals who are sober-minded and fully capable of serving the interests of the public.
Hythe ferry.. Out of use since August 2024, Please investigate why no local councils and government have invested in Hythe pier, Because local council and government have done nothing.

We need an independent inquiry into Ffos y Fran to assess environmental impact, Government need to ascertain the roles and accountabilities that have led to Ffos Y Fran opencast not being properly reinstated as per the original plan., We also need to understand what environmental impacts this is and could cause in its current state
